```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(flowchart)
library(labelled)

data <- read.csv("paper/data.csv")

labels <- get_variable_labels(data)

set_gtsummary_theme(list(
  "tbl_summary-arg:digits" = list(
    all_continuous() ~ 1,
    all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),
    all_dichotomous() ~ c(0, 1)
  )
))

# Wilson score 95% CI for a proportion (matches the method used for the
# responder-rate confidence intervals reported in the manuscript).
wilson_ci <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(est = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA))
  p <- x / n
  denom <- 1 + z^2 / n
  center <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / denom
  half <- (z * sqrt((p * (1 - p) / n) + (z^2 / (4 * n^2)))) / denom
  c(est = p, lower = max(0, center - half), upper = min(1, center + half))
}
```

# Figure 1 - Flowchart

```{r}
#| label: fig-flowchart
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9

data |>
  dplyr::mutate(agudesa_cat = as.factor(agudesa_cat)) |> 
  as_fc(label = "Total patients", text_fs = 10) |>
  fc_filter(
    filter = !exc_nino & !exc_sintom & !exc_diag & !exc_rep & !exc_sint_urg & !is.na(tiempo_sint_urg_hour),
    label = "Central retinal artery occlusion",
    text_pattern = "{label}\n{n}",
    text_fs = 10,
    show_exc = TRUE,
    label_exc = "Excluded",
    just_exc = "left",
    bg_fill_exc = "#ed6f88",
    text_fs_exc = 7
  ) |>
  fc_split(agudesa_cat, text_fs = 10) |>
  fc_split(tiv, text_fs = 10) |>
  fc_draw()
```

```{r}
#| label: dataframes-analisis

data <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(!exc_nino & !exc_sintom & !exc_diag & !exc_rep & !exc_sint_urg & !is.na(tiempo_sint_urg_hour)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    agudesa_cat = factor(agudesa_cat, levels = c("BCVA ≤ 20 letters", "BCVA > 20 letters")),
    tiv = factor(tiv, levels = c("Fibrinolytic treatment", "No-fibrinolytic treatment"))
  )
```

# Table 1 - Demographic baseline characteristics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-demographic
#| tbl-cap: "Demographic baseline characteristics"

xtab <- data |>
  dplyr::select(
    edat, sexe, hta, dm_1, dm_2, dislipemia, cardiopatia_isquemica,
    fibrilacio_auricular, arteopatia_periferica, mpoc, insuficiencia_cardiaca,
    valvulopaties, insuficiencia_renal_cronica, ictus_previs, dependencia_tabac,
    agudesa_cat, tiv
  )

tab1 <- xtab |>
  labelled::set_variable_labels(.labels = labels, .strict = FALSE) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = -c(agudesa_cat, tiv),
    value = list(-c(edat, sexe, dependencia_tabac) ~ "Yes"),
    missing = "ifany",
    type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = all_continuous2() ~ c("{median} [{p25}; {p75}]", "{min}, {max}")
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_header(stat_0 ~ "N = {n}") |>
  # gtsummary::modify_column_hide(n) |>
  gtsummary::add_stat_label() |>
  gtsummary::bold_labels()

tab2 <- xtab |>
  dplyr::filter(agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters") |>
  labelled::set_variable_labels(.labels = labels, .strict = FALSE) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = -agudesa_cat,
    value = list(-c(edat, sexe, dependencia_tabac) ~ "Yes"),
    by = tiv,
    missing = "ifany",
    type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = all_continuous2() ~ c("{median} [{p25}; {p75}]", "{min}, {max}")
  ) |>
  gtsummary::add_stat_label() |>
  gtsummary::bold_labels()

tab3 <- xtab |>
  dplyr::filter(agudesa_cat == "BCVA > 20 letters") |>
  dplyr::mutate(tiv = droplevels(tiv)) |>
  labelled::set_variable_labels(.labels = labels, .strict = FALSE) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = -agudesa_cat,
    value = list(-c(edat, sexe, dependencia_tabac) ~ "Yes"),
    by = tiv,
    missing = "ifany",
    type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = all_continuous2() ~ c("{median} [{p25}; {p75}]", "{min}, {max}")
  ) |>
  gtsummary::add_stat_label() |>
  gtsummary::bold_labels()

gtsummary::tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tab1, tab2, tab3),
  tab_spanner = c("**CRAO population**", str_glue("**{levels(xtab$agudesa_cat)}**"))
)
```

# Table 2 - Procedural time intervals (Sub-cohort 1)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-time-key-events-treatment
#| tbl-cap: "Times of different key events in the patients who received fibrinolytic treatment: intravenous / intra-arterial"

xtab <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters" & tiv == "Fibrinolytic treatment") |>
  dplyr::select(tiempo_porta_agulla_min, tiempo_urg_tev_min, agudesa_cat, tiv) |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(-c(agudesa_cat, tiv), ~ as.numeric(.x)))

xtab |>
  labelled::set_variable_labels(.labels = labels, .strict = FALSE) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = -c(agudesa_cat, tiv),
    missing = "ifany",
    type = everything() ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = all_continuous2() ~ c("{median} [{p25}; {p75}]", "{min}, {max}")
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_header(stat_0 ~ "**BCVA ≤20 letters and Fibrinolytic treatment**<br>N = {n}") |>
  gtsummary::add_stat_label() |>
  gtsummary::bold_labels()
```

# Effectiveness - responders by sub-cohort and time point

```{r}
#| label: tbl-effectiveness
#| tbl-cap: "Proportion (number) of responders by sub-cohort and time point, with 95% Wilson confidence intervals"

grp_of <- dplyr::case_when(
  data$agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters" & data$tiv == "Fibrinolytic treatment" ~ "Sub-cohort 1",
  data$agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters" & data$tiv == "No-fibrinolytic treatment" ~ "Sub-cohort 2",
  data$agudesa_cat == "BCVA > 20 letters" ~ "Sub-cohort 3"
)

resp_long <- tibble::tibble(
  grp = rep(grp_of, 3),
  timepoint = rep(c("24 hours", "1 week", "4 weeks"), each = length(grp_of)),
  resp = factor(
    c(as.character(data$resp_24h), as.character(data$resp_1sem), as.character(data$resp_1month)),
    levels = c("No", "Yes")
  )
) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(resp)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("24 hours", "1 week", "4 weeks")))

resp_long |>
  gtsummary::tbl_strata2(
    strata = grp,
    .tbl_fun = ~ .x |>
      gtsummary::tbl_summary(
        by = timepoint,
        include = resp,
        type = resp ~ "dichotomous",
        value = resp ~ "Yes",
        statistic = resp ~ "{p}% ({n}/{N})",
        label = list(resp = .y),
        missing = "no"
      ) |>
      gtsummary::add_ci(
        method = list(resp ~ "wilson.no.correct"),
        pattern = "{stat}, 95% CI {ci}"
      ) |>
      gtsummary::modify_footnote(gtsummary::everything() ~ NA),
    .combine_with = "tbl_stack",
    .combine_args = list(group_header = NULL)
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_header(label = "**Sub-cohort**") |>
  gtsummary::as_gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold")
```

# Figures 2-4 - Longitudinal OCT trajectories by sub-cohort

```{r}
#| label: oct-setup
#| label: oct-setup
visit_labels <- c("Baseline", "24h", "1 week", "4 weeks")
visit_days   <- c(0, 1, 7, 28)
names(visit_days) <- visit_labels
group_levels <- c("Sub-cohort 1 Responder", "Sub-cohort 1 Non-responder", "Sub-cohort 2", "Sub-cohort 3")
group_colors <- c(
  "Sub-cohort 1 Responder" = "#2E8B22",
  "Sub-cohort 1 Non-responder" = "#D62728",
  "Sub-cohort 2" = "#1F77B4",
  "Sub-cohort 3" = "#FF7F0E"
)
```

## Figura 2 - Grosor macular (OCT-M)

```{r}
#| label: fig-2-octm-data
long_octm <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters" & tiv == "Fibrinolytic treatment" & resp_24h == "Yes" ~ "Sub-cohort 1 Responder",
      agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters" & tiv == "Fibrinolytic treatment" & resp_24h == "No"  ~ "Sub-cohort 1 Non-responder",
      agudesa_cat == "BCVA ≤ 20 letters" & tiv == "No-fibrinolytic treatment" ~ "Sub-cohort 2",
      agudesa_cat == "BCVA > 20 letters" ~ "Sub-cohort 3"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group)) |>
  dplyr::select(pacient, group, v_bas_octm, v_24h_octm, v_1set_octm, v_1mes_octm) |>
  rlang::set_names(c("pacient", "group", visit_labels)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(pacient, group), names_to = "visit", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    visit = factor(visit, levels = visit_labels),
    group = factor(group, levels = group_levels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

summ_octm <- long_octm |>
  dplyr::group_by(group, visit) |>
  dplyr::summarise(median = median(value), lo = min(value), hi = max(value), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(visit_num = visit_days[as.character(visit)])
```


```{r}
#| label: tbl-fig-2-octm
long_octm |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pacient, visit), names_from = group, values_from = value) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_strata(
    strata = visit,
    .tbl_fun = ~ .x |>
      gtsummary::tbl_summary(
        include = -pacient,
        statistic = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{median} [{min}, {max}]",
        type = everything() ~ "continuous",
        missing = "no"
      ) |>
      gtsummary::add_n(statistic = "{N_nonmiss}", col_label = "**N**") |>
      gtsummary::modify_header(label ~ "**Sub-cohort**"),
    .header = "**{strata}**"
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_caption("**OCT macular (foveal) thickness**")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-2-octm
ggplot2::ggplot(summ_octm, aes(x = visit_num, y = median, group = group, colour = group, fill = group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = visit_days, labels = names(visit_days)) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 2) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Thickness (µm)") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```
